name: dw_talents lib_spl — BCS round-trip safety
description: Wraps the _DW_OLD remap DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH in PATCH_TRY to prevent BCS corruption.

ops.find:
COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP ".*\.bcs" override
	PATCH_IF NOT (
		~%SOURCE_RES%~ STRING_COMPARE_REGEXP ~BD.*~ = 0 OR ~%SOURCE_RES%~ STRING_EQUAL_CASE ~C#AJAN~
		OR ~%SOURCE_RES%~ STRING_EQUAL_CASE ~A7!GXRU~
	) BEGIN
		DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH BEGIN
			REPLACE_TEXTUALLY "_DW_OLD" ""
		END
	END
BUT_ONLY
ops.replace:
// _eetmr_bcs_safety: wrapped DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH in PATCH_TRY for round-trip safety
COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP ".*\.bcs" override
	PATCH_IF NOT (
		~%SOURCE_RES%~ STRING_COMPARE_REGEXP ~BD.*~ = 0 OR ~%SOURCE_RES%~ STRING_EQUAL_CASE ~C#AJAN~
		OR ~%SOURCE_RES%~ STRING_EQUAL_CASE ~A7!GXRU~
	) BEGIN
		PATCH_IF INDEX_BUFFER ("_DW_OLD") >= 0 BEGIN
			PATCH_TRY
				DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH BEGIN
					REPLACE_TEXTUALLY "_DW_OLD" ""
				END
			WITH DEFAULT END
		END
	END
BUT_ONLY

name: SCS lib_bcs — BCS round-trip safety
description: Wraps the core BCS editor DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH in PATCH_TRY. Prevents corruption of scripts that can't round-trip.

ops.find:
COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP GLOB ".*\.bcs" override
             SPRINT filename "%SOURCE_RES%"
             DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH BEGIN
                LPF process_baf STR_VAR editstring filename END
             END
       BUT_ONLY
ops.replace:
// _eetmr_bcs_safety: wrapped DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH in PATCH_TRY for round-trip safety
       COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP GLOB ".*\.bcs" override
             SPRINT filename "%SOURCE_RES%"
             PATCH_TRY
                DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH BEGIN
                   LPF process_baf STR_VAR editstring filename END
                END
             WITH DEFAULT
                PATCH_PRINT ~WARNING: [%SOURCE_FILE%] BCS round-trip failed, skipping~
             END
       BUT_ONLY

name: EET_end — ARE size guard
description: Adds a SOURCE_SIZE check before READ_SHORT 0x48 in EET_end's ARE scanning loop. Prevents crash on undersized ARE files (e.g. A7#127.ARE = 52 bytes from Golem Construction).

ops.replace:
// _eetmr_are_guard: skip undersized ARE files that would crash READ_SHORT 0x48
COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP GLOB ~.*\.ARE~ ~override~
	SET flags = 0
	PATCH_IF SOURCE_SIZE >= 0x4a BEGIN READ_SHORT 0x48 flags END

name: EET_end — DLG round-trip safety
description: Wraps EET_end's DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH on all DLG files in PATCH_TRY. Prevents crash on dialogues that can't round-trip.

ops.find:
COPY_EXISTING_REGEXP GLOB ~.+\.DLG$~ ~override~
	DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH BEGIN
		PHP_EACH remapped_states AS file => state BEGIN
			REPLACE_EVALUATE CASE_INSENSITIVE ~\( EXTERN .\)%file%\(. \)\([0-9]+\)~ BEGIN
				SET match = state + MATCH3
				PATCH_PRINT ~Patching %SOURCE_FILESPEC%: %file% => %file_1% - dlg; %MATCH3% => %match% - state~
			END ~%MATCH1%%file_1%%MATCH2%%match%~
		END
		REPLACE_EVALUATE CASE_INSENSITIVE ~\([Tt]Dialog[A-Za-z]*("\)\([^"]+\)"~ BEGIN SPRINT match ~%MATCH2%~ SPRINT res ~dlg~ LPM EET_PCU_outer_res END ~\1%match%"~
	END
BUT_ONLY

name: DSotSC — restore missing source BMPs + COPY_LARGE
description: A previous MOVE operation consumed ar4600sr.bmp/ar8900sr.bmp (renamed them to bg5500sr/bg2400sr). Restore sources from destinations and use COPY_LARGE to make it idempotent.

ops.replace:
// _eetmr_move_fix: replaced MOVE with COPY_LARGE (idempotent, survives retries)
ACTION_IF GAME_IS ~eet~ BEGIN
	COPY_LARGE ~DSotSC/base/bmp/ar4600sr.bmp~ ~DSotSC/base/bmp/bg5500sr.bmp~
	COPY_LARGE ~DSotSC/base/bmp/ar8900sr.bmp~ ~DSotSC/base/bmp/bg2400sr.bmp~
